title: Entire groups generated by fractional powers of operators
summary: Let $T$ be a power-bounded operator on a Banach space $X$. We treat the sequence of polynomials $(p_{n;a})_{n\ge 0}$ such that the entire group generated by the fractional power operator $-(I-T)^a$ is given by $$ e^{-t(I-T)^a}=e^{-t}\sum_{n=0}^\infty p_{n;a}(t)T^n, \qquad t\in \CC, \quad \Re a>0. $$ We provide a self-contained introduction to the polynomial family $(p_{n;a})_{n\ge 0}$, for $a\in \CC$, whose coefficients are determined by means of a suitable recurrence relation.
